import scipy.optimize as so, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
def A(p,e,t): return p[0]*t**p[1] + p[2]*t**p[3]*e**(p[4]+p[5]*t)
rng=np.random.default_rng(5)
best=(1e9,None)
for trial in range(60):
    p0=rng.normal(size=6)*0.7
    try:
        r=so.least_squares(lambda p: A(p,eps,T)-sigma, p0, max_nfev=1500)
        if np.isfinite(r.cost) and r.cost<best[0]: best=(r.cost,r.x)
    except Exception: pass
p=best[1]; res_=sigma-A(p,eps,T)
print(np.round(p,4).tolist())
o=np.argsort(eps)
for k in range(0,300,25):
    idx=o[k:k+25]
    print(round(eps[idx].mean(),2), round(res_[idx].mean(),4), round(np.std(res_[idx]),4))
